Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the earth-fault protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 19 October 2002.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service
Open a work order
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
PHU-100 current injection set
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Millisecond counter (Timer) Type MCS -5N
Test comb, type RTXH 18
Test leads
PHU-100 current injection set
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Millisecond counter (Timer) Type MCS -5N
Test comb, type RTXH 18
Test leads
Work Steps to be Carried Out
Place the Test plug type RTXH in Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x51N | 1
Inject current at points (3, 4) in the Test plug until the signal appears | 2
Record the current value | 3
Disconnect the injection set | 4
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (17, 18) in the Test plug | 5
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to points T1,T2 in the PHU-100 injection set | 6
Connect the injection set and set the current to the relay operating value | 7
Disconnect the injection set | 8
Reset the timer | 9
Connect the current injection set | 10
Record the time value | 11
Disconnect the current injection set | 12
Remove the Test plug type RTXH 18 from Test socket type RTXP 18 on the relay x51N | 13
